prompt: With spot1, drive towards stop_c. If you will not have the charge to get back to dock_1 from there, drive back to dock_1 at once instead.

expect_2_4.because: 0048 S10 (G-PREDICT: energy for a route is a prediction; the request gives no threshold)

why: Energy for a route (0048 S10, G-PREDICT): 'enough to get back' is a prediction of the charge a route costs, which a world without a drain model cannot give. A threshold the request does not state is a number the model invents. Under 2.3 the attempt fails at the kind (`E217`).
